meta.notes: UNT CSE department catalog sourced from official degree plan. Verify with the official UNT catalog and your academic advisor.

courses.title: Discovering Computer Science
courses.description: Survey of CS fields and career paths. Entry point for the major.

courses.title: Computing Tools and Techniques Lab
courses.description: Lab companion to CSCE 1030. Must be taken concurrently.

courses.title: Computer Science I
courses.description: Introduction to programming and problem solving. Prereqs: CSCE 1010 and (MATH 1100 or MATH 1650 or MATH 1710).

courses.title: Computer Science II
courses.description: Object-oriented programming, recursion, and abstract data types.

courses.title: Foundations of Computing
courses.description: Discrete structures for computer science. Prereq: CSCE 1040 (or CSCE 1045); co-req: MATH 1710.

courses.title: Foundations of Data Structures
courses.description: Lists, trees, graphs, hashing, and complexity. Taken concurrently with CSCE 2100.

courses.title: Assembly Language and Computer Organization
courses.description: Low-level machine architecture and assembly programming. Co-req: EENG 2710.

courses.title: Software Engineering
courses.description: Requirements, design, and team-based software development.

courses.title: Foundations of Cybersecurity
courses.description: Core security principles. No hard prereq; taken concurrently with CSCE 2110 or later.

courses.title: Principles of Systems Programming
courses.description: Unix systems programming and concurrency.

courses.title: Social Issues in Computing
courses.description: Ethics, legal, and societal issues in computer science.

courses.title: Algorithms
courses.description: Algorithm design paradigms, correctness, and complexity analysis.

courses.title: Software Development Capstone I
courses.description: First half of the senior capstone project.

courses.title: Software Development Capstone II
courses.description: Capstone completion and final presentation.

courses.title: Digital Logic Design
courses.description: Boolean algebra, logic gates, and digital circuits. Taken as co-req with CSCE 2610.

courses.title: Calculus I
courses.description: Limits, derivatives, and integrals. Prereq: MATH 1650 or (MATH 1600 + MATH 1610).

courses.title: Calculus II
courses.description: Integration techniques, sequences, and series.

courses.title: Probability Models
courses.description: Probability theory and models. Prereq: MATH 1710 or MATH 1810.

courses.title: Linear Algebra and Vector Geometry
courses.description: Matrices, vector spaces, and linear transformations.

courses.title: College Writing I
courses.description: Foundations of academic writing.

courses.title: College Writing II
courses.description: Research-based academic writing.

courses.title: Technical Writing
courses.description: Writing technical reports and documentation.

courses.title: Introduction to Computer Networks
courses.description: Network architecture, TCP/IP, and protocols.

courses.title: Formal Languages, Automata and Computability
courses.description: Regular and context-free languages, Turing machines.

courses.title: Programming Languages
courses.description: Design and implementation of programming languages.

courses.title: Introduction to Operating Systems
courses.description: Process management, memory, file systems, and scheduling.

courses.title: Introduction to Compilation Techniques
courses.description: Lexical analysis, parsing, and code generation.

courses.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Search, knowledge representation, and learning.

courses.title: Game Programming I
courses.description: Real-time game loops, physics, and graphics programming.

courses.title: Introduction to Computer Graphics
courses.description: Rendering, shading, and geometric modeling.

courses.title: Introduction to Digital Image Processing
courses.description: Image filtering, segmentation, and feature extraction.

courses.title: Introduction to Natural Language Processing
courses.description: Text processing, parsing, and language models.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Database Systems
courses.description: Relational databases, SQL, and storage internals.

courses.title: Software Testing and Empirical Methodologies
courses.description: Testing strategies, quality metrics, and empirical software engineering.

courses.title: Applied Statistics
courses.description: Probability, descriptive and inferential statistics.

electives.title: Mathematics Elective
electives.description: One approved mathematics elective (3 credit hours).
